title: Coconut quindim
hookLine: Global-inspired coconut quindim with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Coconut quindim
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Rub 4 ramekins, about 175ml capacity, or dariole moulds liberally with the soft butter. Sprinkle with the caster sugar to coat. Incorporate {m53477_1}, {m53477_2}, {m53477_3}, and {m53477_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: In a medium bowl, press the egg yolks through a wire sieve and mix with the coconut milk, sugar, coconut and vanilla. Pour into ramekins and place in a large roasting tin in the oven. Incorporate {m53477_5} and {m53477_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour water into the roasting tin to three-quarters up the ramekins so it acts like a bain marie or water bath for the quindim. Bake for 30-35 mins until the tops are golden. Take the ramekins out of the water and leave to cool for 5 mins.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Chill for 4 hrs and then run a knife around the edge. Place a plate on top and turn out the quindims to serve. Let Coconut quindim cool for 10–15 minutes so the crumb sets cleanly before slicing into 4 portions, then garnish and serve.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
